analysis: Reviewed the two base_text units of docs/developer/test.md against the patch excerpt. The PR is documentation-only. It updates the 'Last updated' date. It changes the CI description at head lines ~1243-1244 from 'Blacksmith macOS runners' to 'macOS CI runners' with a link to build.md#ci-runner-routing. It changes the test-plan paragraph at head lines ~1808-1811: routed CI jobs now pin per-lane runners and fallbacks, and release workflows stay on literal Blacksmith runners, while the macOS jobs of ci.yml are no longer pinned to literal Blacksmith. No runtime code, key handling, attestation, WebSocket contract, prefix-cache storage (T-041), fan helper or add-on socket behavior is changed. The supplied units (base lines 1846-2772) do not include the changed hunks, which sit at lines 3, 1243 and 1807-1809. The hunk content was therefore judged from the patch excerpt only. The patch excerpt is complete, so I see no concrete security regression. One integration question remains outside the supplied evidence. Routing macOS CI jobs through a runner-routing plane rather than literal runners could affect CI trust, but the workflow files, routing plane and build.md are not supplied. That is an unverified contract, not a finding. Release workflows are described as staying on literal Blacksmith runners, so signed-artifact and qualification paths (A-011, A-017) appear unaffected per the doc text. No threat-model update is needed from this docs change alone.
